teaser: How email works now: the agent drafts and logs, I send, and a decision draft turns the drafts folder into a work queue.
core_idea: An inbox agent that researches, drafts with sources and logs everything, with a person who sends every email, works when the drafts folder becomes a work queue with three labels and decisions are asked as unsent decision drafts answered in the person's own words, letting the person shift into a decision context while the agent carries the before and the after.

figures.caption: The drafts folder as a work queue: a decision draft labelled next/3 decide, two replies labelled next/2 review, and one labelled next/1 send. Example, names invented.

Left: emails sent each week from agent@riskmandate.ai, 4, 64, 48 and 53, from a sample of 169 of the 178. Right: the reasons the draft guard gave when it blocked drafts, led by 28 for a claim with no source.
The loop in six steps: mail comes in; a draft with sources; filed by label; I work the queues; the agent acts on my answers; everything logged.
A decision draft, answered: the instruction at the top, where we are, why it matters, two questions with options, and the answers written into the answer boxes. Example, names invented.
